_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Ètz jogador {player_id} al Tic Tac Toe de tres jogadors.
Vòstre simbòl es '{symbol}'.
Prendètz los vòstres torns per plaçar vòstre simbòl sus una taula 5x5 per formar una linha de quatre.
Las linhas pòdon èsser orizontalas, verticalas o diagonalas.
Presentatz vòstre movement utilizant lo format '[4]' per marcar la cellula 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format de mòde invalid. Utilizar "[cell]" ont la cellula es 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Numèro de cellula invalid: {cell}. Deu èsser entre 0 e {max_cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Lo jogaire {player_id} faguèt un movement invalid.

game_action.placed: Jogador {player_id} plaça son simbòl ({symbol}) dins lo camp ({row}, {col}).
